explanation: Das–Dey–Sharma Conjecture 5.5: if cyc(G) < 2^{π(G)+2}, then G is solvable. cyc counts cyclic subgroups and π counts the prime divisors of |G|, both correctly. The docstring says it was proved as Theorem 7.1 of v2 (using CFSG), and a Lean proof (KitaKen1) is linked. A₅ (cyc = 32 = 2^5) shows sharpness. The statement is correct and solved.
